summary: ZyVersa Therapeutics filed an 8-K Other Events item reporting that effective July 16, 2026, it ceased trading on the OTCQB Venture Market and commenced trading on the OTC Pink Limited Market. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting (beyond a market tier move), issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine current report regarding a change in quotation tier, not a special situation.
